defect_family.class: Parser selection occurs before the promised candidate-format admission.
defect_family.minimal_observation: An ordinary JPEG is rejected on baseline only after one JPEG decoder entry. No malicious/advisory payload used.
defect_family.violated_invariant: Caller-supplied review image is PNG-only; unrelated decoder must not be selected.
defect_family.root_cause: Both Image.open calls omitted Pillow formats and relied on an asset.format check after identification.
defect_family.repair: Preselect PNG at both review opens; normalize UnidentifiedImageError to the existing ValueError rejection API.
defect_family.sibling_search_scope: All three Image.open sites in drafting_control.py reviewed. The third normalizes host rasterizer output and is unchanged; the two caller-supplied review paths are restricted.
defect_family.regression: Normal JPEG decoder-entry observation fails on baseline, passes candidate; valid PNG and unknown verdict gate preserved.
defect_family.preventive_guard: PNG decoder preselection plus a benign other-format regression.
defect_family.verification: 9 candidate unit tests passed; independent fresh evaluation reported a narrow decoder-admission improvement only.
defect_family.rollback: Discard local patch; immutable exact baseline retained.
defect_family.authorization_status: User-authorized local reversible RSI candidate only; no remote write, deployment, merge or promotion.

baseline_new_development_regression.expected_failure: JPEG decoder-entry check; before repair the unsupported decoder is entered.
